items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a Gil Evans written session.

ctx.x: I don’t know. Maybe he made – Miles might have needed some direction or something. But Teo was pointing. I remember him being in the background and pointing to where he was supposed to be on the music. That was a Gil Evans written session.
I might have jumped ahead in my chronology, but I remember it was on that date that Elvin was playing too.
